questions.q: Which technique did Caravaggio use for dramatic dark shadows and a strong spotlight?
questions.why: Tenebrism is very dark shadow with a spotlight on the subject; sfumato is soft blending.

questions.q: Where did the name 'Impressionism' come from?
questions.why: A critic took the name from Monet's Impression, Sunrise, shown at the group's 1874 exhibition.

questions.q: Which artist is a Post-Impressionist who used thick, expressive brushwork?
questions.why: Van Gogh moved beyond Impressionism with thick strokes and emotional colour.

questions.q: Describe two features of Impressionist painting.
questions.model: They used short, broken brushstrokes of bright colour to show shimmering light, and often painted outdoors quickly to capture a moment, without black.
